text: nice you did find it. so uh yeah one more question why doesnt everything have this capability? like payphone or dumpster also for example
resolution: Answered why not every prop had the skinning capability: props split into data-recipe kinds (rendered by the generic DataProp, skinnable) and ~15 bespoke hand-built components (Payphone, Dumpster, Tree, Rock, furniture, lights, signs…) that drew their own meshes and exposed no parts — so payphone/dumpster/etc. had nothing to skin, and they also baked as fallback boxes (a render/bake parity gap). RESOLVED by the req_0782 migration: a single shared resolvePropParts feeds render + bake from one recipe per prop, and every prop now flows through DataProp, so all of them are click-to-skin and bake their skins uniformly. No separate code change owned by this id — it folds into req_0782 (live in the working tree, held from commit pending a695's recipe files).
